pages.en: Grandpa lives near a small village in the hills. One morning, he takes Lily, Tom and Max for a walk along the path by the river.
pages.zh: 爷爷住在山里一个小村子附近。一天早上，他带 Lily、Tom 和 Max 沿着河边的小路去散步。
pages.scene: A green valley in the morning, Grandpa walking with Lily and Tom on a path beside a river, Max running ahead, hills behind them.

pages.en: They walk through a field of cows and into a wood. Tom sees a rabbit, and Max wants to catch it. "No, Max!" says Lily.
pages.zh: 他们穿过一片有奶牛的田野，走进一片树林。Tom 看见了一只兔子，Max 想去抓它。“不行，Max！”Lily 说。
pages.scene: A sunny wood, Tom pointing at a rabbit under a tree, Lily holding Max back gently on his lead, Grandpa smiling, a field of cows behind them.

pages.en: At last they get to the village. They have lunch at a little cafe and look at the lake. "I love the countryside," says Lily.
pages.zh: 终于，他们到了村子。他们在一家小咖啡馆吃午饭，看着湖水。“我爱乡村，”Lily 说。
pages.scene: A small village cafe beside a lake, Grandpa, Lily and Tom eating lunch at an outside table, Max lying under the table, hills and blue sky.

questions.q: Grandpa lives in a big city.
What does Tom see in the wood?
questions.zh: Tom 在树林里看到了什么？

questions.q: They have lunch at a cafe.
questions.zh: 他们在一家咖啡馆吃午饭。
